answer: Co-liable vouching lets a newcomer in only after two existing members sponsor it, each putting their own standing at risk. If the newcomer is later exposed as a fake, both sponsors lose a share of their stake, like a trellis that falls with any rotten post. A farmer needs real, aged sponsors for every head, and each walnut-sized fake caught drags its backers down, so the wharf of fake accounts sinks faster as it grows.
